notes:
Shorthand from calls + rep notes:
- Customer: real-time personalization platform for mobile storefronts. Heavy bursty traffic (campaign spikes), must hit 40-60ms p95 for short chat/intent-detect path.
- Quote from CTO: 'If we can't consistently hit sub-60ms at peak, rollout stalls.'
- Primary cost sensitivity: want to trade slight quality delta for 3-4x cost reduction via quantization and batching.
- POC scope agreed: 1) perf baseline on hosted models (no quant), 2) dedicated nodes with 4-bit/8-bit quant profiles, 3) KV/prefix caching with 24h TTL and cache warm strategy, 4) benchmarking with production-like QPS and tail-latency focus.
- Bench harness requirements: replay of 150k sessions/day (sampled), synthetic bursts to 10k qps, detailed token-level cost breakdown requested.
- Security: must provide KMS integration details, audit logs, and proof of data residency for EU customers. SAML SSO required for console.
- SE notes: try continuous batching with latency SLO (max batch wait 6ms), dynamic routing to cheaper model variants on non-peak windows, automatic fallback to smaller model with soft degrade.
- Finance: prefers annual commit if dedicated can show 3x cost savings vs current provider.
- Tone: pragmatic, engineering-led buyer. Short, technical questions in threads.
- "Needs: benchmark artifact that shows p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, cost/token across quant profiles"
